name: ship-change
description: An infrastructure change from request to production, safely: implement and plan (Terraform/OpenTofu, Kubernetes or Compose), peer review by a platform engineer and an IaC security review, the DevOps gates, human approval of the exact plan (by its sha256), apply/deploy, health and smoke verification, automatic rollback on failure, and a change record.

change.description: What to change, as you would write it in a ticket.

dir.description: Where the code lives (module folder, manifests folder, or compose file)

target.description: How to reach the target: Key Vault secret names and names, e.g. "env AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=cloud-aws-key-id", "kubeconfig kubeconfig-staging, namespace shop", "compose project shop, dockerHost docker-host-prod"

smoke.description: Smoke checks to run after the change (commands or URLs that must succeed)

allowDestroy.description: "yes" if the change may destroy or replace resources; otherwise any destroy blocks the run

planHash.description: sha256 of the plan file to apply (Terraform/OpenTofu), or empty

planSummary.description: The plan or diff summary the human approves

applied.description: The change was applied or deployed

policy.title: Record the run's destroy policy
policy.command: mkdir -p .harness/devops && case {{input.allowDestroy}} in yes|true|YES|Yes) d=true;; *) d=false;; esac && printf '{"allowDestroy": %s}\n' "$d" > .harness/devops/run-policy.json && rm -f .harness/devops/plans/latest.json .harness/devops/plans/latest.md

change.title: Implement and plan
change.prompt:
Implement this infrastructure change in the workspace, then prove it. Do not apply or deploy anything.

<change>
{{input.change}}
</change>
Kind: {{input.kind}}. Where: {{input.dir}}. Target: {{input.target}}
Feedback from an earlier review or approval, if any: {{feedback}}

- terraform: iac fmt (write) and validate, then iac plan for {{input.dir}} (with the Key Vault env the target names). planHash is the sha256 it printed; planSummary is its summary.
- kubernetes: k8s validate, and k8s diff for {{input.dir}} against the target cluster when it is reachable; planHash is empty; planSummary is the diff summary (objects and what changes).
- compose: container lint/scan for the images' Dockerfiles; planHash is empty; planSummary says which services change to which images.
Run the quality_gates tool and fix what fails.

Report what you changed (files) and why each destroy or replacement, if any, is needed.

peer-review.title: Platform engineer review

security-review.title: IaC security review

address.title: Address the reviews

fix.title: Fix failing gates
fix.prompt:
The DevOps gates failed. Fix the causes (not the gates), then make the plan or diff again exactly as before (planHash and planSummary of the NEW plan). If a destroy is reported and it is not needed, change the configuration so it is not destroyed; if it is needed, say so - the run must be started with allowDestroy=yes.

{{feedback}}

approve.title: Approve the plan

apply.title: Apply / deploy
apply.prompt:
The human approved this change. Ship it.

Kind: {{input.kind}}. Where: {{input.dir}}. Target: {{input.target}}
- terraform: iac apply with planHash {{state.planHash}} (pass allowDestroy: true only if destroys were allowed - allowDestroy input: {{input.allowDestroy}}). Never make and apply a different plan.
- kubernetes: k8s apply of {{input.dir}} (it waits for the rollouts).
- compose: deploy up as the change describes, with the health check.

The approved plan or diff:
{{state.planSummary}}

applied is true only if the apply/deploy finished without error.

verify.title: Verify health and smoke checks

rollback.title: Roll back

record.title: Change record

failed.title: Not shipped (or rolled back): see the change record
